features.inventory: Manage hosts, groups, and inventory snapshots
features.execution: Cancelable, replayable, and auditable Ansible runs

auth.singleAdminHint: Sign in with a local administrator account.
auth.multiAdminHint: Administrator sessions are protected by passwords and TOTP when enabled by deployment policy.
auth.activationHint: Enter the one-time activation code provided by an OWNER and choose a password of at least 12 characters.
auth.enrollHint: Add this secret to your authenticator, then enter the current six-digit code.
auth.verifyHint: Enter an authenticator code or one unused recovery code.
auth.totpSecretHint: This secret is displayed once. Never put it in a Playbook, log, or chat.
auth.recoveryHint: Each recovery code works once. Store them in a protected password manager; they cannot be shown again.
auth.recoverySaved: I saved these recovery codes securely
auth.reauthenticationHint: Enter your current password and second factor. Sensitive operations remain authorized for ten minutes.
auth.passwordReauthenticationHint: TOTP is disabled by deployment policy. Enter your current password; sensitive operations remain authorized for ten minutes.

errors.invalid_credentials: The username or password is incorrect.
errors.invalid_or_expired_session: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.origin_not_allowed: This application origin is not allowed.
errors.auth_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
errors.request_validation_failed: Check the submitted fields and try again.

errors.reauthentication_required: Reauthenticate within the last ten minutes to perform this operation.

errors.activation_expired: The activation code is invalid, used, or expired.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.description: Live view of hosts, queue activity, and recent automation.
dashboard.architectureHint: API and Worker share an image; PostgreSQL provides queueing, leases, locks, events, and rate limiting.
dashboard.recentRunsHint: Newest automation ordered by creation time.

hosts.title: Hosts
hosts.description: Manage SSH connection data, credential binding, and trusted host keys.
hosts.name: Host name
hosts.variablesHint: System-managed ansible_* connection variables cannot be overridden.
hosts.variablesInvalid: Host variables must be a valid JSON object.
hosts.trustWorkflow: Before the first connection, an administrator must scan and confirm the SSH host key. Unknown fingerprints are never trusted silently.
hosts.webShellConfirmMessage: This opens an interactive terminal on “{name}”. The host cannot run automation while connected, and terminal input and output are not recorded. Continue?
hosts.webShellPopupBlocked: The browser blocked the new window
hosts.webShellPopupHint: Allow pop-ups for this site, then try again.
hosts.deleteConfirm: Delete host “{name}”? Hosts with run history cannot be deleted.
hosts.confirmationRequired: This host has no confirmed SSH host key. Verify a fingerprint below; the connection test will start after confirmation.
hosts.confirmationRequiredRun: One or more target hosts have no confirmed SSH host key. Scan and confirm them in Hosts first.
hosts.keyHint: Verify {host}'s fingerprint out of band before confirming.

webShell.title: OpsComposer Web Shell
webShell.securityNotice: Terminal content exists only in this connection and browser memory; it is never recorded or audited.

errors.host_busy: This host is busy with another Run or Web Shell. Try again later.
errors.web_shell_capacity_reached: The global Web Shell capacity is full. Close another session first.
errors.host_key_confirmation_required: This host has no confirmed SSH host key. Return to Hosts, scan it, and verify the fingerprint manually.
errors.web_shell_session_expired: The session ticket expired. Reconnect to create a new session.
errors.web_shell_unavailable: Web Shell is unavailable. Check the host, credential, and service state.
errors.web_shell_protocol_error: The terminal received invalid data and was closed safely.
errors.web_shell_frame_too_large: A terminal input frame exceeded 64 KiB and the connection was closed.
errors.validation_error: This host cannot start a Web Shell in its current state.

reasons.START_FAILED: the SSH client could not start
reasons.SLOW_CONSUMER: the browser was receiving too slowly

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Organize hosts into flat groups resolved to immutable run snapshots.
groups.name: Group name
groups.variablesInvalid: Group variables must be a valid JSON object.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.description: Manage password and SSH private-key credentials protected with AES-256-GCM and the Master Keyring.
credentials.name: Credential name
credentials.rotationHint: Rotation creates an immutable revision; existing runs keep their pinned version.
credentials.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? Deletion is rejected while assigned to a host.
credentials.securityNote: Passwords, private keys, passphrases, and ciphertext are never returned through the API, logs, or SSE.
credentials.privateKeyLocalHint: The file is read only in browser memory and submitted directly; its path is never retained.
credentials.privateKeyTooLarge: A private key file cannot exceed 1 MiB.
credentials.versionConflict: Another request changed this credential. Refresh and try again.
credentials.reauthenticationHint: Credential writes require password and MFA reauthentication. Secrets are never logged or audited.

commands.title: Quick command
commands.description: Run controlled Ansible Command tasks or explicitly confirmed Shell tasks.
commands.shellWarning: Shell supports pipes, redirects, and expansion and is riskier than Command. Verify targets and content.
commands.shellAcknowledge: I understand a remote shell interprets this command and I verified its impact
commands.shellConfirmMessage: This may contain pipes, redirects, or compound operations. Create the run now?
commands.queueNote: The intent is persisted in PostgreSQL before a Worker claims it.

playbooks.title: Playbooks
playbooks.description: Manage database Playbooks and run Ansible Playbooks from database or read-only mount sources.
playbooks.name: Name
playbooks.sourceModeHint: Current source mode: {mode}. Database content is Web-managed; mounted content is always read-only.
playbooks.emptyHint: Create a database Playbook or check the enabled source configuration.
playbooks.databaseIsolationHint: A database Playbook is a single-file project and cannot implicitly use roles, templates, files, or vars from the mounted directory.
playbooks.disabledRun: A disabled Playbook cannot create a new run.
playbooks.deleteConfirm: Delete “{name}”? Historical runs keep their pinned revision.
playbooks.versionConflict: Another request changed this Playbook. Refresh and try again.
playbooks.sourceUnavailable: This Playbook source is not currently enabled.
playbooks.pinnedRevision: Submission pins database revision r{revision}; later edits cannot change this run.
playbooks.mountedHash: The mounted file SHA-256 will be verified at submission: {hash}…
playbooks.extraVarsInvalid: Extra variables must be a valid JSON object.
playbooks.schemaHint: Only the controlled JSON Schema subset is supported; mark sensitive strings with x-ops-composer-sensitive.
playbooks.schemaInvalid: The parameter schema must be a valid JSON object.
playbooks.zipHint: Import creates only a browser working copy. The project reaches PostgreSQL only after validation and save.
playbooks.zipImported: ZIP loaded into the working copy
playbooks.restoreConfirm: Create a new current revision from r{revision}?
playbooks.unsavedConfirm: The Playbook working copy has unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
playbooks.sensitiveHint: encrypted and consumed once; never persisted in snapshots, logs, or events
playbooks.secretParametersRequired: Retrying this Run requires sensitive parameters again.

users.title: Administrator governance
users.description: Manage fixed global roles, account status, activation, and MFA. Users are never hard-deleted.
users.totpPolicyDisabled: TOTP is disabled by deployment policy. Existing factors remain encrypted and resume when re-enabled; sensitive actions currently use password reauthentication.
users.activationHint: No email is sent. Deliver the one-time activation code through a secure channel.
users.activationOneTime: This code is shown once and expires in 24 hours. Only its hash is stored.
users.activationSaved: I delivered or saved the activation code securely
users.sessionRevocationHint: Role or status changes immediately revoke every session for this user.
users.resetMfaConfirm: Reset MFA for “{name}” and revoke all sessions? Enrollment is required at the next sign-in.
users.lastOwner: The last active OWNER cannot be disabled or demoted.
users.versionConflict: Another request changed this user. Refresh and try again.
users.reauthenticationHint: User governance requires password and MFA reauthentication.

security.title: Personal security
security.description: Manage your password, TOTP, recovery codes, and sensitive-operation elevation.
security.totpPolicyDisabled: TOTP is disabled by deployment configuration. No seed is generated or returned; sign-in and sensitive-operation reauthentication use passwords only.
security.passwordMismatch: The new passwords do not match.
security.enrollOneTime: The seed is displayed once. Ten one-time recovery codes are generated after confirmation.

audit.title: Business audit
audit.description: Query immutable lifecycle and governance events. Terminal and raw Ansible output are never audited.
audit.empty: No audit events in this range

runs.title: Run history
runs.description: Inspect replayable command, Playbook, and connection-test history.
runs.search: Search run ID, type, or operation

runDetail.title: Run detail
runDetail.cancelConfirm: The Worker stops Ansible at a safe checkpoint. Request cancellation?
runDetail.noEvents: No events yet; SSE will resume automatically.

system.title: System
system.description: Inspect runtime configuration, Project Forge provenance, and dependency health.
system.totpPolicyDisabled: TOTP is disabled by deployment configuration. The system currently uses password authentication and Doctor reports degraded status.
system.doctorHint: Only non-sensitive configuration and dependency state are shown.
system.keyringHint: PostgreSQL stores only verification envelopes and reference counts. Keys are loaded only from the permission-restricted deployment file.
system.rotationQueued: The online re-encryption job was queued in PostgreSQL
system.rotationReauth: Master Key rotation is restricted to OWNER and requires password and MFA reauthentication.
